summary: Implementation fully satisfies the saved local resource reservation plan: dind_slots is migrated and persisted; workspace resource requests reserve CPU, memory, disk, and DinD; queue decisions compute active capacity snapshots from existing latest reservations plus the new request; metrics, API, and console expose steady/peak reservations, available capacity, and pressure reasons; terminal cleanup release and auto-profile DinD reconciliation are idempotent; owned-path overlap remains advisory; and no multi-node or GKE scheduling was added. Validation passed: ruff, mypy, focused resource/scheduler/status/API/provisioner tests, full unit suite, console lint/typecheck/build, and the 99% coverage gate at 99.06%.
